title: Term of copyright in sound recording
text:
27. Term of copyright in sound recording.—In the case a [sound recording] copyright shall subsist

[until [sixty years] from the beginning of the calendar year next following the year in which the [sound](http://www.manupatrafast.in/ba/dispBotC.aspx?nActCompID=190672&iActID=4767#s27f1)
recording] is published.
